reviews.comment: this class was so boring and he didn't do a very good job at explaining anything. without a strong background in geometry, this class is going to be very hard for you to take. this prof puts me to sleep almost every class. would not reccomend
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Weekly hw, 2 papers, a midterm, & final. Some class participation but you pick partners & its easy. There is a writing question on each hw & exam that you get to submit a revision for. HW questions come from the book (you can find online for free). He grades the papers leniently if you meet the requirements. Study his old exams to ace the exams!!

I have a very split opinion. He made no lecture videos. His lecture notes were extremely hard to understand (he used unfamiliar notation without explaining symbols/superscripts/subscripts and jumped past explanations). The textbook he chose was equally difficult to parse (no illustrations). But, he was a lenient grader and flexible on due dates.

The class was very disorganized, students like us have a really hard time understanding the materials as well as when it comes to preparing for the exams. Be sure to attend class and get ready to answer questions, write them out on the board and explain it to the rest of the class for class activity points.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: 467 was probably the easiest math class I have taken, largely because he's pretty lenient with grading. He explains concepts well if you meet him in office hours, but class can be a bit of a drag. Really, just show up and get your attendance credit. Use the reviews and old exams to study, and you'll be just fine. Oh, and don't procrastinate.

He is a boring lecturer, but I like the way he ran his class. Homework was a little difficult, but very doable. You'll have to work a little bit for the A but it's not too hard. Really nice guy, but very old. Attendance is required and he expects you to participate in class discussions.
